title: Water-right caravan to political-party offices
location: Fuentes de Beethoven roundabout and party offices, San Salvador
organizer: Alianza Nacional contra la Privatización del Agua
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown. The report names Alianza organizations and three representatives but gives no crowd count; membership or workforce totals are not substituted.

occurrence_dates_location.summary: Gato Encerrado reports that the Alianza gathered at Fuentes de Beethoven in San Salvador on Feb. 22 and began visiting party offices at 09:10.

organizer_demands.summary: The stated goal was to deliver letters seeking legislation for the human right to water; a specific original demand category is unresolved.

responses.summary: Party staff received letters; this does not establish a state response. Other responses remain unknown.

end_date.summary: The article gives the route but no physical end date or time.

notes: Body-read evidence confirms a public caravan with a demand for water-right legislation. The article does not establish >=50 participants. The original codebook has no explicit environmental/water-right demand category; classification is left open for review.
open_questions: Verify whether at least 50 people participated.
Review coding of the water-right demand under original categories.
Determine the physical end of the caravan.

title: Ministry of Culture union stoppage over delayed food-card payments
location: Ministry of Culture facilities; signs outside the National Palace, San Salvador
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown. The article reports more than 1,100 ministry employees as the workforce, not the number taking part; no protester turnout is stated.

occurrence_dates_location.summary: Gato Encerrado reports the stoppage began Feb. 11, with two signs outside the National Palace, and ended at midday Feb. 12 as work resumed.

organizer_demands.summary: Three ministry unions supported the action over unpaid food-card amounts promised under the Ministry collective agreement.

participants.summary: The report cites more than 1,100 ministry employees as the workforce only; no attendance figure is given.

responses.summary: The article explicitly reports that the culture minister did not address workers’ demands. This `ignore=yes` records only that reported ministerial nonresponse; other response dimensions remain unknown.

end_date.summary: Unions lifted the stoppage at midday Feb. 12 and said activities resumed that afternoon.

notes: The reported 1,100-plus ministry employees are the workforce, not turnout. The body reports three unions stopped work and placed signs outside the National Palace; it does not report a participant count. Eligibility stays pending the >=50 threshold and public-action rule. `ignore=yes` records only the explicit report that the culture minister did not address demands; this mapping remains for coordinator review.
open_questions: Establish whether at least 50 workers joined the stoppage or public sign display.
Review whether the public signs and workplace stoppage satisfy the manual’s public-action rule.
Calibrate the reported ministerial nonresponse against the original ignore response definition.
